name: Build & Ship a Game with Blender + Unity

screen_game_setup.hook: Three tools make one flat-screen game. Name them.
screen_game_setup.recall: The stack for a flat-screen game?
screen_game_setup.answer: Blender (assets) + Unity (engine) + an AI coding agent (the C#)

blender_modeling.hook: Before you code a game you need things to put in it. Where do the 3D assets come from?
blender_modeling.recall: What do you make in Blender for a game?
blender_modeling.answer: the 3D models / characters / props, then export them for Unity

import_pipeline.hook: Your Blender model has to show up in Unity correctly. How?
import_pipeline.recall: How do Blender assets get into Unity?
import_pipeline.answer: export FBX/GLTF + textures -> import to Unity, set materials + colliders

ai_coding_game.hook: You don't hand-write all the C#. How does an AI agent build the game with you?
ai_coding_game.recall: How does an AI agent help build the game?
ai_coding_game.answer: describe the behavior in English -> it writes the C# -> you test + iterate

game_mechanic.hook: What's the one central action your whole game is built around?
game_mechanic.answer: the central verb run every frame: input -> update -> render

character_movement.hook: A character that won't move isn't a game. How do you drive it?
character_movement.recall: How do you move a character (PC + mobile)?
character_movement.answer: input (keyboard/touch) -> a controller moving it via physics/transform

camera_systems.hook: The player only sees what the camera shows. What's its job?
camera_systems.recall: Role of the camera in a screen game?
camera_systems.answer: follow + frame the player — it's the player's window into the world

game_ui.hook: Score, health, menus — where do they live?
game_ui.recall: What UI does a game need?
game_ui.answer: menus, a HUD (score/health), pause — built on a canvas

game_audio2.hook: Why does even a simple game feel dead without sound?
game_audio2.recall: Role of audio in a game?
game_audio2.answer: SFX + music give feedback and set the mood — they make actions feel real

mobile_touch.hook: Same game, now on a phone. What has to change?
mobile_touch.answer: touch controls + a tighter performance budget + orientation + Android/iOS build settings

game_perf_mobile.hook: A phone isn't a gaming PC. How do you keep it smooth?
game_perf_mobile.recall: How do you keep a mobile game smooth?
game_perf_mobile.answer: limit draw calls + poly count, compress textures, hit the frame budget

publish_game.hook: It's done — get it in front of players. How?
publish_game.recall: How do you publish a flat-screen game?
publish_game.answer: build for the platform (PC/itch.io/Play Store), make a listing, release
